h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bharatpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bharatpur

items.pText: Bharatpur in eastern Rajasthan is best known for Keoladeo National Park, the wetland bird sanctuary that draws birdwatchers and families in the winter months. The hotels and resorts that host them are among our likely buyers here, along with schools and colonies in the town. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 990 km from Bharatpur, and delivers it by road.

A family that comes to see birds will often stay a night or two, and children need somewhere to play between outings. A small play area on a resort lawn fills that gap. It works better when the equipment fits the setting. Our design team has created play structures based on birds, animals and nature, and these suit a property that sells itself on wildlife. We also supply standard swings and slides for schools that want a simpler set.

items.q: Do you have playground equipment with a bird or wildlife theme?
items.a: Yes. Our Funplay Originals range includes designs such as Chidiyaan and Flamingo Park, created by our own team. They use galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts with our standard warranty.

items.q: Where should a resort place its play area?
items.a: Within sight of the dining area or lawn seating, and away from the pool, driveway and parking. We mark the safe play area on the layout drawing so you can see how it fits.
